plugins.name: api-design
plugins.description: The api-design role on contract v3 (issue-160 round-3 promotion). Decides: 서비스 경계의 인터페이스 형태.

plugins.name: adr-section-gate
plugins.description: issue #7: enforces the ADR-shaped proposal norm (issue #1) on api-design phase-1 proposals — context/decision/alternatives considered/rationale/consequences all present and non-empty.

plugins.name: evidence-citation-gate
plugins.description: issue #7: enforces the evidence-citation discipline (issue #1) on api-design phase-1 proposals — every standard/common/established-practice claim must name a source in the same paragraph.

plugins.name: interface-spec-gate
plugins.description: issue #7: enforces the API-First deliverable norm's interface-spec facet on api-design phase-2 records, per Zalando RESTful API Guidelines rules 101-102 (Provide API Specification using OpenAPI).

plugins.name: resource-model-gate
plugins.description: issue #7: enforces the API-First deliverable norm's resource-model facet on api-design phase-2 records, per Zalando's resource-naming rules (nouns not verbs, plural collections, consistent hierarchy).

plugins.name: versioning-strategy-gate
plugins.description: issue #7: enforces the API-First deliverable norm's versioning-strategy facet on api-design phase-2 records, per Zalando's API-versioning rule (URI-path/media-type versioning, semver discipline).

plugins.name: deprecation-plan-gate
plugins.description: issue #7: enforces the API-First deliverable norm's deprecation-plan facet on api-design phase-2 records, per Zalando's Deprecation rule built on RFC 8594 §3 (Sunset header) + Zalando's Deprecation header.
